scoring_justification: Full KMC simulation cannot be re-run in the verifier (T1 infeasible). We verify the agent's reported results by (a) comparing lifetime and migration distance at three key charges (0, -4e, -12e) to the paper's approximate values within a factor‑2 tolerance, and (b) checking that both quantities increase monotonically with charge magnitude across all seven charges. This combination provides a robust verification of the reproduction.

outputs.description: Agent-reported adatom lifetime and migration distance for each charge state. Checker will compare to hidden reference values for selected charges and verify monotonic increase.

output_contract.notes: The DFT and NEB steps are computationally intensive and expected to run on external/HPC resources. The KMC simulation must cover all seven charge states with 400k trajectories each. The checker applies tolerance-based comparison to paper-reported values (factor 2) and checks monotonic trend.

hidden_assets.purpose: golden reference values for lifetime and migration distance at charges 0, -4e, -12e
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper Fig. 3 and text: lifetime ≈10 μs (0), ≈27 μs (-4e), ≈160 ms (-12e); migration distance ≈25 nm (0), ≈100 nm (-4e), ≈13 μm (-12e)
hidden_assets.generation_method: converted to SI units and embedded as gold map
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: these numbers are directly read from the paper's reported approximate values; used as tolerance check

steps.description: Validate that results.json is an array of 7 objects covering all required charges with correct keys and numeric types.

For charges 0, -4e, -12e, check that lifetime_s and migration_distance_m lie within [gold/2, gold*2] of the paper-reported approximate values. Score is the fraction of the 6 quantities that satisfy the tolerance.
Verify that lifetime_s and migration_distance_m are non‑decreasing as charge magnitude increases (most negative to zero). Score is 0.5 per quantity if monotonic.
